description: This file contains extension methods for consuming unknown fields during serialization/deserialization in Orleans. It defines static methods to handle different wire types and process fields accordingly.

methods.name: ConsumeUnknownField
methods.description: Consumes an unknown field based on its wire type, handling reference, varint, tag delimited, length-prefixed, fixed32, fixed64, and extended wire types.

methods.name: ConsumeUnknownField
methods.description: Overloaded method that consumes an unknown field with a scoped reference to the field, handling special cases like references and delegating to other methods.

methods.name: ConsumeTagDelimitedField
methods.description: Recursively consumes fields within a tag-delimited field until the end of the object or base fields.
